step_by_step_reasoning: Analyze the whiteboard architecture: Users upload PDF documents to S3. This triggers events on EventBridge. EventBridge invokes Step Functions, which orchestrates Lambda functions to process the document. Lambda calls a SageMaker real-time endpoint for page analysis and Amazon Textract for text extraction. Finally, Step Functions posts a completion event back to EventBridge.

graph.name: Docebo AI-Powered E-Learning Content Generation
graph.notes: Orchestrated pipeline to ingest PDFs and extract semantic content, reducing document noise by 80% to generate e-learning content.

nodes.name: End User
nodes.notes: Uploads PDF documents to the application.

nodes.name: S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores uploaded raw PDFs and converted page images.

nodes.name: Amazon EventBridge
nodes.notes: Routes file upload and processing completion events.

nodes.name: AWS Step Functions
nodes.notes: Orchestrates the multi-stage document ingestion and cleaning pipeline.

nodes.name: AWS Lambda
nodes.notes: Performs tasks like converting pages to images and driving custom ML prediction steps.

nodes.name: Amazon SageMaker
nodes.notes: Hosts custom ML model endpoint to identify and filter document noise.

nodes.name: Amazon Textract
nodes.notes: Extracts text from page images for semantic analysis.

edges.notes: S3 file creation triggers upload events.
EventBridge triggers Step Functions workflow execution.
Step Functions invokes Lambda execution steps.
Lambda invokes SageMaker model endpoint to analyze page layouts.
Workflow invokes Textract to extract text content.
Workflow publishes processing completion events back to the main bus.
